notes.title: "Schrödinger's Call" Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that the free demo version of Schrödinger's Call is now available!

[b]Schrödinger's Call Free Demo Availability Period:
[/b]April 22, 2025 (Tue) 5:00 PM PDT - May 12, 2025 (Mon) 1:00 AM PDT (tentative)

[b]Supported Languages:
[/b]Japanese / English / Chinese (Traditional) / Chinese (Simplified)

This demo offers about 20 minutes of gameplay, featuring a portion of the game's prologue specially adjusted for the demo version. It is the same content previously showcased at offline events.

We are also proud to announce that Schrödinger's Call has been selected as an official title for LudoNarraCon, an online event starting May 1 (PDT).
https://www.ludonarracon.com/

Our development team is working hard on the full game, and we greatly appreciate your continued support!

notes.title: Answered the Call at WePlay Expo Shanghai 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750311/4ed4acd48f813665058c3ae9da334393448dcd71.png[/img]

We were thrilled to showcase Schrödinger's Call at WePlay Expo in Shanghai on November 16-17 at the Shueisha Games booth! Visitors explored a haunting adventure with Mary, the main character with no memory, guiding her to save lost souls through a mysterious phone that connects to those who cannot die. Attendees joined Mary on her journey to uncover her past and rescue these wandering spirits.

About WePlay: The largest indie game gathering in China, WePlay is a must-attend event for fans of PC, console, and mobile games, offering an immersive celebration of cultural trends and exclusive experiences. Held at Hall H4 of the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center, the event featured everything from board games to anime, merchandise, and beyond.

We hope you enjoyed stepping into the unknown with Schrödinger's Call!
